notes: ZOMBIES STORY: THE GREEN CURE. A drug trial at Blackwell General went wrong: a painkiller called LAZARUS-9 got sold on the street as NIGHTSHADE, and everyone who took it came back. The weed is the only thing keeping the four survivors human.

7 CHAPTERS: LIGHTS OUT (find 3 fuses and get the power on), HAROLD'S BADGE (a keycard on a body in the ER), BURN THE STASH (3 Nightshade stashes), PATIENT ZERO (a huge glowing purple boss - kill him and take his blood), THE PHARMACY, THE GREEN CURE (cook the cure for 60 seconds while the horde attacks) and an EPILOGUE with a cliffhanger.
Finish the story and you get every perk, an upgraded gun and 5000 points.
12 audio tapes hidden around the hospital tell how it all happened. Tapes you find stay found in the lobby.
The four survivors talk to each other at the start of every chapter and every few rounds, with subtitles.
Your current objective is shown on screen, and the lobby lists all 7 chapters. In co-op everything is shared: fuses, items, the boss and the cooking.
